texto.Number of hours available per week: 20 or more, flexible, and able to scale up for a longer production block
texto.Hourly rate you're looking for: Open to aligning with your band for the role; as a reference, around USD 45 per hour on a freelance contract, and flexible for ongoing project work.
texto.Cover Letter:
My field is 3D character art. Your expression of interest lists Character Modeler and Texture/Shader Artist under 3D, and that is the work I have done for ten years.

I am a Senior 3D Character Artist. At Angel Studios I modelled and hand painted the season one characters of The Wingfeather Saga. For almost five years at E-Line Media I have taken hero characters from sculpt to engine on Endstar, working remotely with an American team. Before that I did character outsourcing at PUGA Studios.

On a production I deliver the whole character asset: high poly sculpt, retopology, UVs, bake, texture, LODs and engine integration. Grooming in Houdini is a supporting strength, and stylised design is where I am strongest, which suits kids and family work.

My portfolio holds more than 45 projects with over 60 characters across many titles, and my personal projects are some of the strongest pieces in it.

I am outside the United States and Canada, so I would need work authorization sponsorship for anything on payroll. For remote freelance contractor work, which is what these roles are, I can invoice from where I am, and I am open to relocating as well.
